title: Add bookmark creation endpoint and UI

assumptions.description: POST /api/bookmarks returns 201 with the created bookmark object including id, url, title, folderId, and createdAt fields
POST /api/bookmarks returns 409 with body { error: 'You already have this bookmark saved' } when the user already has a bookmark with the same URL

scenarios.title: Save a new bookmark
given: The user is on the bookmarks page
when: The user submits a URL 'https://example.com' with title 'Example Site'
then: A new bookmark is created with the URL 'https://example.com' and title 'Example Site'
The bookmark appears at the top of the user's bookmark list

scenarios.title: Reject duplicate bookmark URL
given: The user already has a bookmark with URL 'https://example.com'
when: The user submits a new bookmark with URL 'https://example.com'
then: An error toast displays 'You already have this bookmark saved'

decisions.decision: Bookmarks table: id (UUID PK), user_id (FK to users), url (text, unique per user via composite unique constraint on user_id + url), title (text), folder_id (nullable FK to folders), created_at (timestamp default now).
decisions.rationale: Per-user URL uniqueness enforced at the database level prevents duplicates without application-level race conditions.

decisions.decision: POST /api/bookmarks (body: { url, title, folderId? }) returns 201 + bookmark object or 409 if duplicate.
decisions.rationale: 409 for duplicate gives the frontend a clear signal to show the error toast in SC-02.

decisions.decision: Use react-hot-toast. Success toasts auto-dismiss after 3 seconds. Error toasts persist until dismissed.
decisions.rationale: Lightweight, supports both auto-dismiss and persistent behaviors needed by SC-01 and SC-02.

files.description: POST handler: validate session, check for duplicate URL (user_id + url unique constraint), insert bookmark, return 201 with bookmark object or 409 with error message.
Form component with URL and title inputs. On submit, calls POST /api/bookmarks via React Query mutation. Shows success toast on 201, error toast on 409.
Renders the user's bookmarks from a React Query query. New bookmarks appear at the top (ordered by created_at DESC).
Add bookmarks table and folders table definitions with the schema from the data model decision.
